details:
Our project Brahmand Ganga.

We are MVA Robotics Innovation Org. We work on real life problems solving solution. Team Name: Reborn Innovators. Team Leader: Ashish Kumar.

Here we not only provide health monitoring and solutions, we provide complete package for Astronaut.

The main Brahmand Ganga frontend includes a Health Panel with Bio Revive AI and Brain MRI Intelligence, and an Experts Panel for doctors and scientists to monitor astronaut health. https://brahmand-ganga-frontend.vercel.app/

We take the daily activity record through our Brahmand Ganga Space Health App. Here Astronaut puts their daily basis routine along with health vital reading done by Space Health Centre. After putting heartbeat, SpO2, smoking, drinking and daily screen time on computer / laptop / mobile and sleep hour, then our AI Trinity will come up with analysis report and give details for improvement. - https://bio-revive-ai-genius.vercel.app/

they can monitor health status and make themselves ready for mission. When they are with Family members .it helps them to get ready for the mission

We have face analysis computer vision based AI enabled face health monitoring app which scans face every detail like eye redness and facial textures and Active or dull. Our AI can detect gesture and expressions. When they are in Space Mission we have different web app for monitoring and helping in their schedule and which helps them in space challenge -https://mva-universe-project.vercel.app/astronaut-health-lab.html

We have Todo planner ZyvaOne app where astronaut can add and plan their activity. Our app is not limited to when Astronaut is at space but during his time and schedule in Earth. Using ZyvaOne app we can manage and add reminders and calendar pin option.

We have now feature like browsing all heavenly bodies. We have used NASA API and ISRO API and GPS navigation live through satellite and street view mode, such that while in space they can browse this in their workstation.

We have specially created Health Space Lab App for monitoring his vital organs in space suits and we have shown some modifications through our 3D space suits. In Space there are problems different for female and old astronaut. We have designed all our Health Lab in such a way that it will help.

We have 3D Rotating heavenly bodies Sun, Earth, Mars with distance and analysis. We have all planets, dwarf planets, some related to them and our Milky Way galaxy and Black Hole with distance parameters and we can rotate, shift and move angles of viewing. We have entire Solar System in 3D and Cosmic App with computer vision with detection - if anything comes in their place it detects and shows.

Brahmand Ganga includes an interactive Map with Satellite Mode and Street Mode with Satellite view, so users can explore space locations, Earth and astronaut routes in both views.

Our App gives mental peace by browsing Space and health care all in one complete package.

For example, in our Expert Panel,Brahmand Ganga is a wellness screening prototype, not a medical device. All expert profiles shown in the app are demo / sample profiles for demonstration only, not real doctors. For final diagnosis, we have added Experts Panel, Doctor and health experts connecting features and health experts can join our app. Astronaut can view profile, check rating and consults, check availability Today or Tomorrow, and book Free Session or consultation. Our AI recommends for future process.

Tools Used: NASA API, ISRO API, GPS Satellite Navigation, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Computer Vision AI, 3D Modelling, ElevenLabs for Ashish voice, CapCut for video.

Team: Ashish Kumar (Leader), Hephzibah Toppo (Presenter), Prakash Kumar (Member).

Our team member Hephzibah Toppo, despite facing physical challenges, is actively working for innovation in space and health technology through Brahmand Ganga. Her dedication proves that innovation has no barriers. We together designed one app also for Disabled people and we won prize earlier 11k previous month.

Brahmand Ganga is a wellness screening prototype, not a medical device. For final diagnosis, we have added Experts Panel, Doctor and health experts connecting features and health experts can join our app.
